software.spreadsheet_reader: openpyxl 3.1.5; raw workbook data stored in input JSON

method.icc: One-way random-effects ICC(1,1) and ICC(1,5), conditional on the five quality-selected retained walks; trial positions treated as exchangeable, not confirmed chronological order.
method.bootstrap: Participant-cluster percentile bootstrap; resample entire five-walk vectors; 5000 replicates per metric/sample.
method.selection: Three metrics chosen for feasibility before association testing; results are exploratory, not a preregistered confirmatory analysis.

limitations: Original protocol collected ten 12-m walks and retained the best five. This analysis cannot estimate the effect of selection because discarded walks are unavailable.
These are retained-trial repeatability estimates, NOT between-day test-retest reliability, smartphone/AI validation, or clinical meaningful-change thresholds.
Within-person SD includes biological performance variation and measurement/processing variation, which cannot be separated.
Absolute symmetry indices are nonnegative and can have a positive noise floor; low ICC can reflect restricted between-participant variation, not only within-participant error.
Percentile bootstrap intervals are exploratory and may be biased near ICC boundaries in small samples.
ICC(1,5) is derived from the same estimated variance components, not an independent empirical validation of averaging five walks.
No fall prediction, clinical score association tests, outcome-based variable selection, model training, or p-values computed.
Independent participant counts are 44 (primary) and 31 (age >=65 sensitivity), not 220.
Institutional ethics/IRB determination, analysis-plan review and complete novelty review remain unresolved.
